_comment: Zone policy for PallaDrive. DATA, not code — a schema change is an edit here, never a code change. Paths are relative to vault_root, matched longest-prefix-first.
_vault_root_note: Machine-agnostic. Resolution order: ctx.get_config('vault_path') -> PALLADRIVE_PATH env (tests only) -> first candidate below that CONTAINS the marker file. A path that does not contain the marker is never accepted, so a stale entry cannot silently win. olympus1 is listed first because that is the runtime host.

zones.label: canonical runtime
zones.reason: _system-files holds canonical runtime components — config, core_text, plugins, skills, crons, scripts. Writing here changes how you work. Say explicitly that you intend to write it.

zones.label: machinery you maintain
zones.reason: _meta holds the drive map, templates and your worklog — machinery you maintain. Read _meta/DRIVE-MAP.md before writing here.

zones.label: reference bank
zones.reason: _wiki is the reference bank — concepts, baselines, the weakness ledger and drill queue.
